entries.name: Binding chain
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Binding chain

*A coil or grasping limb closes around the target and braces against its struggling weight.*

**Target:** One creature within 2 squares. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Grappled 2. **Standard defense:** Grappled 1.

**Limit:** The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

entries.name: Hook the Retreat
entries.effect: After an enemy voluntarily retreats from adjacent to 2 squares: pull 1.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Hook the Retreat

*The hooked limb follows the withdrawing foe, catching just as the space opens between them.*

After a visible enemy voluntarily moves from adjacent to this creature and ends that movement exactly 2 squares from it, pull that enemy 1 square toward this creature along a clear path. Apply Stability, terrain costs and normal collision rules. No separate attack damage. Forced movement and movement granted by a free attack cannot trigger this; it is an alternative to spending the Reaction on an opportunity attack.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Unbroken locks hang open beside empty cells.

**Purpose:** Collect people who believe they owe a debt.

**Tactics and retreat:** Pull a target out of formation and seize on the following turn.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Challenge the claimed debt, break line of sight, and keep an ally ready to use Force.

**Habitat:** Prison; infernal breach · **Communication:** Common and Infernal

**Loot:** A prison key, debt records and 90 coins held in trust for its master.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-chain-jailer


**Category:** Fiend · **Role:** Capturer · **CV:** 34

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hooked chain | Brawn | 1 Boon | 4 physical damage. | 6 physical damage. Pull 1. | 8 physical damage. Pull 2. |
| Binding chain | Brawn | 1 Boon | 2 physical damage. | 3 physical damage. Grappled 1. | 5 physical damage. Grappled 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 4/6/8

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.5

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.4 → 1.5: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.000, O=5.596. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [drag under](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/drag-under.md), [Hook the Retreat](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/hook-the-retreat.md), [seizing limbs](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/seizing-limbs.md).
